title: Standardization of the Simple Methodology for Experimentally Induced Ischemic Stroke in Rat Models
author: Prakoso, Yos Adi
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Prepare animal cohort
steps.instruction: Obtain 60 male Sprague‑Dawley rats and randomly assign them to five groups: Group 1 (sham‑operated) and Groups 2‑5 (ischemia) with common carotid artery ligation durations of 1 h, 2 h, 4 h, and 8 h respectively.

steps.title: Anesthetize and prepare surgical site
steps.instruction: Anesthetize each rat (method as per institutional protocol), shave the neck region, and disinfect the incision area.

steps.title: Expose right common carotid artery
steps.instruction: Make a sagittal ventral midline incision, retract the neck muscles, and expose the right common carotid artery (CCA) and its branches.

steps.title: Ligate carotid artery branches
steps.instruction: Place simple interrupted sutures to ligate the three sides of the carotid artery—common, external, and internal carotid arteries—using a single suture knot.

steps.title: Maintain ligation for prescribed time
steps.instruction: For Groups 2‑5, keep the ligation in place for the assigned duration (1 h, 2 h, 4 h, or 8 h). For Group 1, do not ligate (sham).

steps.title: Re‑perfuse by releasing ligature
steps.instruction: After the allotted ligation time, cut the suture knot to restore blood flow through the CCA.

steps.title: Collect tissue and blood samples
steps.instruction: At 1 day and 7 days post‑reperfusion, euthanize the rats and harvest brain tissue and blood for analysis.
